chunks.title: Excellent Rating
chunks.description: Strong relationship, most likely to interest user. Exact/near-exact match, developer match, direct competitors, core functionality match.

chunks.title: Good Rating
chunks.description: Some relation, quite likely to interest but others more compelling. Close functionality, accessory/add-on, same ecosystem.

chunks.title: Acceptable Rating
chunks.description: Slight relation, user not surprised but not likely interested. Same broad category, same developer different theme, not in locale.

chunks.title: Bad Rating
chunks.description: No relation, would surprise user. Mandatory comment. Surface word overlap pitfall, context mismatch.

chunks.title: Game-Specific Evaluation
chunks.description: Three dimensions for games: play style, presentation/theme, audience. Game IP matching, competitor evaluation.

chunks.title: Special Rules & Exceptions
chunks.description: Do not penalize for reviews/price/descriptions. Unavailable apps. Developer matching. Direct competitors. Context and locale knowledge.

chunks.title: Comment Requirements
chunks.description: Mandatory comments for Bad ratings. Comment structure template. Pre-submission checklist. Never mix query/app across questions.

chunks.title: Locale & Context Knowledge
chunks.description: How locale affects interpretation. BBC example. Abbreviation and local service code research. App Store market differences.
